# AshleyBands website agent instructions

Before inspecting, planning, editing, running commands, or changing external state in this
repository, read `/PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md`, `/AGENTS.md`, and `/CLAUDE.md` in full.

`PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md` is mandatory. Every meaningful repository change must have a sanitized GitHub
issue before implementation, follow the defined workflow states, and satisfy the applicable
definition of done. Never place private student, family, payment, attendance, measurement, contact,
credential, or other protected program information in this public repository or its GitHub records.
